blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for Glenwood. It has no local notes, street boundaries, schools or listing feed yet; see the open items below.

Glenwood, Port Coquitlam: 39 houses and 41 condos and townhomes listed at the end of September, with 1 and 7 sold in the month. It is one of 10 communities the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures break out for Port Coquitlam.
Glenwood homes listed and sold, June to September 2026

Glenwood, September 2026. Detached houses: 39 listed at month end and 1 sold in September, a sales ratio of 3% (a buyers’ market). Condos and townhomes: 41 listed at month end and 7 sold in September, a sales ratio of 17% (a balanced market).

On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. blocks.text: Between June 2026 and September 2026, detached houses: listings fell from 40 in June to 39 in September (−2.5%), and it took 13.9% of the city’s 72 sales over the period; condos and townhomes: listings fell from 42 in June to 41 in September (−2.4%), and it took 17.2% of the city’s 151 sales over the period.

The monthly write-ups singled out Glenwood for detached houses in June, August, September (a buyers’ best bet); condos and townhomes in July (a sellers’ best bet); condos and townhomes in June (a buyers’ best bet).
Glenwood share of Port Coquitlam listings and sales by month

In Glenwood, its share of the houses listed in Port Coquitlam went from 23.3% in June to 25.5% in September and its share of the condos and townhomes listed went from 18.3% to 18.3%. A share that holds steady while the city moves means the community is following the city; a share that drifts means it is moving differently.

blocks.text: Glenwood home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

45 condos sold in Glenwood with a median price of $512,000 (the middle half sold between $426,000 and $580,000), taking a median of 36 days to sell at 97.1% of the last list price; 4% sold above list. They had a median $576 per square foot, a median year built of 1996 and a median strata fee of $408 a month. 23 houses sold in Glenwood with a median price of $1,300,000 (the middle half sold between $1,129,000 and $1,381,000), taking a median of 27 days to sell at 96.1% of the last list price; 0% sold above list. They had a median $538 per square foot, a median year built of 1973 and a median lot of 6,000 square feet.

blocks.text: Lots and land in Glenwood PQ
What trades here

items.t: Fee-simple lots — the default form: single-detached homes sit under RS1, RS2, RS3 and RS4 zones in Port Coquitlam Zoning Bylaw No. 3630, with minimum lot widths of at least 15 m (RS1), 12 m (RS2), 30 m (RS3) and 9.5 m (RS4) — zone minimums AS THE RESEARCH STATES THEM. Typical Glenwood lot dimensions: UNVERIFIED, so no typical size is carried. A fee-simple lot carries no strata corporation, no Form B and no strata fees. - Zoning Bylaw 2008.pdf
Bare-land strata position: no bare-land strata development offered as vacant lots is verified for this ground.
Age-position guardrail: Do not confuse it with Shaughnessy Park (the Glenwood townhouse complex above) or Shaughnessy Square. Glenwood itself verifies ZERO 55+ ownership stock.
No manufactured-home park: NO manufactured-home park exists in Port Coquitlam in any source — there is no pad-tenure product on this ground, and no park is invented or imported here.

blocks.text: Streets, schools and getting around Glenwood PQ

items.t: Glenwood is not named as an established neighbourhood in the City's Official Community Plan — it sits inside the City's north-side residential area — and its boundary roads are UNVERIFIED: no City neighbourhood map defining Glenwood's boundaries was found on an official source.

Where it sits: north Port Coquitlam, between Lougheed Highway to the south and the Citadel / Oxford Heights area to the north and east; nearby areas are Citadel PQ and Oxford Heights (north/east), Lincoln Park (east), Central Pt Coquitlam (south across Lougheed Highway) and Coquitlam (west). Lougheed Highway runs along the south side, with Coast Meridian Road and Lincoln Avenue as north–south routes.
Sub-area medians are UNVERIFIED — SnapStats publishes medians at community level only.

A significant portion of Port Coquitlam is within the Fraser and Pitt River floodplain protected by dykes; Glenwood sits on the north side and lot-level floodplain status is UNVERIFIED, checked with the City. No ALR land was confirmed inside Glenwood. - Zoning Bylaw 2008.pdf

Schools (SD43 Coquitlam, Ministry-listed names): Glen Elementary School (3064 Glen Drive) is the school inside the sub-area. Locator result documented in the research (SD43 School Locator, run 2026-10-23): for the sample address 3064 Glen Drive the locator returned Glen Elementary, École Maple Creek Middle and Pinetree Secondary. Catchments are address-based — any other address is UNVERIFIED without its own locator run.

Parks, recreation and transit: the City Parks Directory lists north-side parks including Evergreen Park at 3500 Cedar Drive; Hyde Creek Recreation Centre at 1379 Laurier Avenue is the north-side recreation centre, and the Terry Fox Library is at the Port Coquitlam Community Centre, 2150 Wilson Avenue. TransLink buses connect north Port Coquitlam with Coquitlam Central Station (Millennium Line Evergreen Extension and West Coast Express) and Port Coquitlam Station (West Coast Express); specific route numbers through Glenwood are UNVERIFIED. Driving commute times: UNVERIFIED.

Health and shopping: the nearest hospital is Eagle Ridge Hospital, 475 Guildford Way, Port Moody (Fraser Health), with Royal Columbian Hospital in New Westminster the next larger hospital. No shopping centre or grocery store location serving this sub-area was verified on an official source: UNVERIFIED.
How people search for it: "Glenwood Port Coquitlam," "Glenwood PoCo." No other official alternate name was confirmed: UNVERIFIED.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect land buyers in Glenwood PQ

items.t: OCP — City of Port Coquitlam Official Community Plan Bylaw No. 3838, which governs the area; no Glenwood-specific plan or major project was confirmed.

Zoning — Port Coquitlam Zoning Bylaw No. 3630: single-detached homes under RS1–RS4 (minimum lot widths at least 15 m / 12 m / 30 m / 9.5 m respectively); townhouse zones RTh1, RTh2 and RTh3 exist in the bylaw. Any parcel's actual zone: per-parcel with the City. - Zoning Bylaw 2008.pdf

Subdivision and servicing — Port Coquitlam servicing bylaw number UNCONFIRMED (held, never borrowed): Neighbouring cities' numbers (e.g., Coquitlam 3558, 2003; Surrey 8830, 1986) govern their own municipalities only and are NOT Port Coquitlam numbers. (Standing verified ledger, applied by exclusion.)

Property taxes — City of Port Coquitlam (a municipality; follow its own research): 2026 taxes were due July 2, 2026, with a 5% penalty on current taxes unpaid after July 2, 2026 and a further 5% after September 15, 2026; the City's 2026 increase was 1.95% for the average home, and the City states it has the lowest average property taxes and utility fees in Metro Vancouver. Utility bills are flat annual water and sewer fees, billed separately and due March 31, 2026.

ALR block (applies only where a parcel is ALR — none confirmed inside Glenwood, status per-parcel): subdivision within the ALR requires Agricultural Land Commission approval; ALR residences cannot be stratified (ALC Bulletin 09 s.6; SPA s.239; ALCA s.21(1)). Caps: principal ≤500 m², suite within principal only, additional residence 90 m² (≤40 ha) / 186 m² (>40 ha).

blocks.text: Good to know about Glenwood PQ

items.t: Detached Glenwood was the city's slowest pace that month (Sep 2026). A land buyer pricing a teardown here is pricing off the wider city market, not the street.

Utilities are a separate flat bill with its own deadline (Mar 31, 2026). Port Coquitlam bills water and sewer as flat annual fees separate from property taxes, due March 31 — a second annual deadline a lot buyer used to combined municipal billing misses.

The city claims Metro Vancouver's lowest average tax-and-utility load (2026). The City states it has the lowest average property taxes and utility fees in Metro Vancouver, with a 2026 increase of 1.95% for the average home — a City claim, carried as the City states it.
The sub-area's school anchor is also its locator proof point (Oct 23, 2026).

Three similar names, three different products (Nov 1, 2026). Shaughnessy Park (Glenwood townhouses, 3655 Shaughnessy St), Shaughnessy Square (2099 Lougheed Hwy, counted city-wide in condos) and The Shaughnessy (2789 Shaughnessy St, the city's only high-rise, general-market) are routinely confused in feeds — only the first is Glenwood ground, and none of the three is 55+.

faq.q: How many homes are for sale in Glenwood?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 39 houses and 41 condos and townhomes listed in Glenwood. Those are month-end counts and they move daily, so ask Jared for a current list.

faq.q: Is Glenwood a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses had a sales ratio of 3% (a buyers’ market); condos and townhomes had 17% (a balanced market). The sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed; on the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers. One month in one community is a small sample, so look at the monthly table above before you decide.

faq.q: How many homes sold in Glenwood from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 10 houses and 26 condos and townhomes sold in Glenwood over those 4 months; detached houses peaked in July with 4 sold and condos and townhomes peaked in July with 8 sold.

faq.q: How big is Glenwood compared with the rest of Port Coquitlam?
faq.a: In September 2026, Glenwood held 25.5% of the 153 detached houses listed in Port Coquitlam and 18.3% of the 224 condos and townhomes listed in Port Coquitlam.

faq.q: What mix of houses and condos is for sale in Glenwood?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses made up 48.8% of the 80 homes listed in Glenwood and condos and townhomes made up 51.2%; of the 8 that sold, houses were 12.5% and condos and townhomes 87.5%.

faq.q: Are there more or fewer homes for sale in Glenwood than in June?
faq.a: Listings of detached houses fell from 40 in June to 39 in September 2026 (−2.5%); condos and townhomes fell from 42 in June to 41 in September 2026 (−2.4%).

faq.q: What did condos in Glenwood sell for?
faq.a: 45 condos sold in Glenwood between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $512,000.

faq.q: How long do condos take to sell in Glenwood?
faq.a: The median was 36 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 97.1% of the last list price (4% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: Is Glenwood an official Port Coquitlam neighbourhood?
faq.a: No — it is a board (MLS) sub-area name used in the SnapStats GVR report; the City's OCP does not name Glenwood as an established neighbourhood, and its boundary roads are UNVERIFIED on any official source.

faq.q: How many units can an RS lot take without rezoning?
faq.a: 3 to 6 small-scale multi-unit housing units, depending on lot size, location and transit proximity, per the City's SSMUH position — confirm for the exact lot with the City.

faq.q: What are the minimum lot widths here?
faq.a: By zone in Bylaw 3630: at least 15 m (RS1), 12 m (RS2), 30 m (RS3) and 9.5 m (RS4). Typical Glenwood lot dimensions are UNVERIFIED — the zone minimum is not the typical lot. - Zoning Bylaw 2008.pdf

faq.q: Is Shaughnessy Park — or The Shaughnessy — a 55+ complex?
faq.a: Neither. Glenwood verifies zero 55+ ownership stock.

faq.q: Which schools serve a Glenwood home?
faq.a: For the documented sample address 3064 Glen Drive, the SD43 locator (run 2026-10-23) returned Glen Elementary, École Maple Creek Middle and Pinetree Secondary; catchments are address-based, so run the exact address — any other address is UNVERIFIED without its own run.
